			if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_gp_patronage_index < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 0 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_v49_gp_act_commission_masterwork_tt
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 275 } } add = 14 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 160 } } add = -12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { at_war = no } } add = 6 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { prestige < 50 } } add = 12 }
	}
}

oe_v49_gp_act_military_treatise = {
	icon = reform_imperial_armies
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 110
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v49_gp_mod_military_treatise }
		}
	}
	cooldown = {
		type = oe_v49_gp_act_military_treatise_cd
		years = 6
	}
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = {
			situation:oe_sit_v49_great_persons = {
				add_to_list = source
			}
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:oe_sit_v49_great_persons = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -110
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_gp_mod_military_treatise years = 12 mode = replace }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_participant value = 1 }
			add_army_tradition = 5
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 35 } }
			change_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index add = 6 }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_gp_patronage_index > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 100 } }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_gp_patronage_index < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 0 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_v49_gp_act_military_treatise_tt
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 270 } } add = 14 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 155 } } add = -12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { at_war = no } } add = 6 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { at_war = yes } } add = 14 }
	}
}

oe_v49_gp_act_grand_salon = {
	icon = host_olympiad
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_v49_mp_gp_country_eligible = yes
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 105
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_v49_gp_mod_grand_salon }
		}
	}
	cooldown = {
		type = oe_v49_gp_act_grand_salon_cd
		years = 6
	}
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = {
			situation:oe_sit_v49_great_persons = {
				add_to_list = source
			}
		}
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:oe_sit_v49_great_persons = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -105
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v49_gp_mod_grand_salon years = 12 mode = replace }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_participant value = 1 }
			add_prestige = 4
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_gp_14_seen } } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_14_seen value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v49_gp.14 }
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 35 } }
			change_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index add = 8 }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_gp_patronage_index > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 100 } }
			if = { limit = { var:oe_v49_gp_patronage_index < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v49_gp_patronage_index value = 0 } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_v49_gp_act_grand_salon_tt
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		add = 10
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold >= 265 } } add = 14 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { gold < 150 } } add = -12 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { at_war = no } } add = 6 }
		if = { limit = { scope:actor = { is_great_power = yes } } add = 10 }
	}
}
